If every swing spent one, Flurry would be up less of the fight: about 11 DPS less for the dual-wield Fury warrior and 3 for the two-handed one. Enhancement shamans' Flurry works the same way. A warrior's Heroic Strike or Cleave spends a charge of its own a cast, as a Forever log shows (EV-0138).
